div.div: Each step is a snapshot of the protocol at one moment, not a transformation of the step before it. It is a folder in examples/uuid_protocol/steps with a readme, the generated project (gal.cfg, GaL, XSLT) and the code written by hand, and every step builds and runs a real client and server.
